stories.title: Ben Affleck's "I Voted" smoking photo updates the tired-Affleck meme
stories.summary: An Election Day paparazzi photo of Ben Affleck smoking, eyes closed, with an "I Voted" sticker was paired with his classic 2016 tired-and-smoking photo and became the image for how everyone felt after election night.

stories.title: Telegram: "i can't believe bill gates named that company after his penis"
stories.summary: Telegram's official X account posted the joke, and the replies filled with MACROHARD edits and arguments over how far brand accounts should go.
